cards.name: Aragorn
cards.text: Sentinel. The first player gains control of Aragorn. Action: Spend 1 resource from Aragorn's pool to ready him. (Limit once per phase.) If Aragorn leaves play, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor: "As I have begun, so I will go on.." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Gwaihir
cards.text: Ranged. Sentinel. When Revealed: The first player must choose: either take control of Gwaihir, or spend 1 [fellowship] resource and discard Gwaihir to discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Shadow: This attack deals no damage.
cards.shadow: Shadow: This attack deals no damage.

cards.name: Embassy from The Dark Tower
cards.text: Setup: Add The Black Gate and The Mouth of Sauron to the staging area. Set Gwaihir aside, out of play. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Dire. When Revealed: In player order, each player places the top card of his deck faceup in front of him until there are a total of 4 faceup player cards between the players. Place the top 4 cards of the encounter deck faceup. Starting with the highest cost player card, pair each player card with the highest threat encounter card remaining until there are 4 pairs. For each pair, the first player must choose: either discard both cards in that pair, or reveal the encounter card to play the player card at no cost.

cards.name: Snaga Archer
cards.text: Archery 2. Forced: After Snaga Archer engages you, deal 2 damage to a character you control.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if the defending character is damaged).

cards.name: Beleaguered Hills
cards.text: While Beleaguered Hills is the active location, reduce the total [threat] in the staging area by X, where X is the total [threat] of each engaged enemy. Forced: After Beleaguered Hills becomes the active location, each player engages a non-unique enemy in the staging area.

cards.name: Rage Filled Him
cards.text: When Revealed: The Mouth of Sauron makes an immediate attack against you. If this attack destroys a character, raise your threat by 4.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+3 [attack] instead if it is The Mouth of Sauron).

cards.name: Slopes of Cirith Gorgor
cards.text: Forced: When Slopes of Cirith Gorgor leaves play, the first player shuffles the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discards cards from the top until an enemy is discarded. Then, he puts that enemy into play engaged with him.

cards.name: The Hour of Doom
cards.text:
Doomed 1.
When Revealed: Each player must choose: either raise your threat by 1 for each character you control, or discard the highest cost ally you control.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard a non-objective attachment you control.

cards.name: The Battle of Morannon
cards.text: Dire When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a different Orc, Troll, or Nazgûl enemy to the staging area. Shuffle Gwaihir into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Dire. During the staging step, the first player does not reveal an encounter card as normal. Instead, he reveals 1 encounter card for each resource on The Black Gate. Forced: After the players quest unsuccessfully, discard the active location.  This stage cannot be defeated. Each round the players survive gives the Ring-bearer more time to fulfill the quest to Mount Doom.

cards.name: Hell-hawk
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Either search the encounter deck, discard pile, and victory display for a Nazgûl enemy and add it to the staging area, or attach Hell-hawk to a Nazgûl enemy in play. (Counts as a Mount attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per enemy. Attached enemy gets +2 [threat], +2 [attack], +2 [defense] and is immune to player card effects.")

cards.name: Uruk Soldier
cards.text: Forced: After Uruk Soldier engages you, raise your threat by 2.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. If this attack destroys a character, return attacking enemy to the staging area.

cards.name: Onslaught of Mordor
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player deals 1 damage to a questing character he controls. Until the end of the phase, each damaged character gets -1 [willpower] and cannot be healed.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Engage it and deal it a shadow card.

cards.name: Wall of Morannon
cards.text: While Wall of Morannon is the active location, each enemy and location in the staging area is immune to player card effects. Forced: After Wall of Morannon becomes the active location, return each engaged enemy to the staging area.

cards.name: Warrior of Rhun
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Choose a questing character you control and remove it from the quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending character cannot ready until the end of the round.

cards.name: Waste of Dagorlad
cards.text: While Waste of Dagorlad is the active location, treat the text box of each ally as if it were blank (except for Traits).

cards.name: Orc of Mordor
cards.text:
Surge.
Forced: After Orc of Mordor engages you, exhaust a character you control.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Exhaust a character you control.

cards.name: The Mouth of Sauron
cards.text: Immune to player card effects. Cannot leave the staging area. Forced: After a player cancels a 'when revealed' effect, The Mouth of Sauron makes an immediate attack against that player.

cards.name: The Black Gate
cards.text: Immune to player card effects. The players cannot travel here. The Black Gate gets +1 [threat] for each resource on it. Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, place 1 resource here and raise each player's threat by 1.

cards.name: Easterling Bowman
cards.text:
Peril. Archery 1.
When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to a questing character you control.
cards.shadow: Shadow: After this attack, attacking enemy engages the next player then makes an attack.

cards.name: Jaws of Steel
cards.text: When Revealed: Each players assigns X damage among characters he controls, where X is the number of resources on The Black Gate.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] for each resource on The Black Gate.

cards.name: Towers of the Teeth
cards.text: Immune to player card effects.  X is the number of characters controlled by the player with the most characters. While Towers of the Teeth is the active location, players cannot play allies.

cards.name: Nazgûl of Mordor
cards.text: Cannot have non-Morgul attachments. Forced: After Nazgûl of Mordor attacks, either raise your threat by 4, or return Nazgûl of Mordor to the staging area.

cards.name: Reeking Moat
cards.text: Forced: After Reeking Moat becomes the active location, choose a non-unique, non-Nazgûl enemy in the staging area and place it facedown under Reeking Moat. Forced: When Reeking Moat leaves play, put each enemy under it into play engaged with the first player.

cards.name: Gorgoroth Hill-troll
cards.text: Cannot have attachments. Forced: After Gorgoroth Hill-troll attacks and destroys a character, the defending player discards a random card from his hand and raises his threat by that card's printed cost.
